model.title: Making National Parks Safer Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Barrasso (R-WY)

summary.text: The bill would direct the National Park Service to assess its existing emergency communications centers and develop a plan to upgrade them to Next Generation 911 systems, which use modern digital technology to receive emergency calls more reliably and securely across different agencies and locations.
